name: The Adventurer's Guide to Britain
overview:
TV Presenter Gethin Jones and naturalist Charlotte Uhlenbroek abandon Britain's well-trodden tourist trail in search of places only those with the true spirit of adventure get to experience--the most inaccessible and little known sights, sounds and heritage of the UK. Gethin and Charlotte need courage, endurance and strong nerves as they try to uncover these hidden gems of our landscape, wild life and history.

Highlights of the series include:

• Flight by microlight over Derbyshire's Peak District - fabulous 360° views.

• Sea Kayaking off the North Yorkshire coast in search of hidden coves and fossils that are 180 million years old.

• Deer stalking one of England's oldest wild red deer herds near Ullswater in the Lake District.

• The trek to see one of England's longest waterfalls and white-water tubing on the raging river Tees.

• Grey seals, smuggler's caves and shipwrecks off the Pembrokeshire coast.

• Exmoor's three faces - moorland, high cliffs and beautiful woodland
